classification: fixed-weight audit of R490 five-leg subset using train+validation IC/stability; test/recent confirmation; no promotion unless all gates pass
known_limits: IC weighting is estimated from historical data and is not guaranteed to persist.
All variants share the same five legs and are correlated.
Test/recent windows are reused confirmation windows.
Current HS300 membership retains survivorship bias.
5x cost is warning-only and never a hard rejection.
No leverage and no production activation.
